editor.label: Description
editor.description: Shown in the server list.

editor.label: Message of the day
editor.description: Shown to players when they join.

editor.label: List publicly
editor.description: Shows the server in the public server list.

editor.label: Admins can pause
editor.description: Lets an admin pause the server when they are the only player online.

editor.label: Galaxy seed
editor.description: Used when the galaxy is generated (first start). Empty = a random seed. Changing it later does not regenerate the galaxy: delete galaxies/avorion_galaxy (or reinstall) for a new one.

editor.label: Scenario
editor.description: Creative: unlimited resources and free building.

editor.label: Hardcore
editor.description: Permanent death: a destroyed player ship is gone with everything in it.

editor.label: Behemoth events
editor.description: From the free Behemoths DLC.

editor.label: Same start sector
editor.description: Off = each new player starts in a random empty sector on the outer rim.

editor.label: Collision damage
editor.description: 0 = no damage, 1 = full damage.

editor.label: Ships per player
editor.description: -1 = unlimited.

editor.label: Stations per player
editor.description: -1 = unlimited.

editor.label: Blocks per ship
editor.description: -1 = unlimited.

editor.label: Fighters per sector and player
editor.description: -1 = unlimited.

editor.label: Sector update threads
editor.description: More threads use more CPU cores.

editor.label: Simulated sectors per player
editor.description: Sectors with player property that keep running when the player is elsewhere.

editor.label: Automatic galaxy backups
editor.description: The server writes its own backups to the backups folder.

editor.label: Admin Steam IDs
editor.description: SteamID64s of the server administrators, separated by commas. They are added to admin.xml at start; remove an admin with /admin -r <name> in the console.

configFiles.description: Mods (modconfig.lua). The Steam Workshop page adds and removes Workshop mods here.
Whitelist: one SteamID64 per line (Access list = Whitelist)

script.name: Prepare the galaxy
script.description: Writes the config editor settings into server.ini (the server overwrites it on every save), gives a new galaxy a random seed when the Galaxy seed setting is empty, and creates modconfig.lua when it is missing.

script.name: Save the galaxy and shut down
script.description: Sends /stop (saves the galaxy and shuts down) and waits until the server exits.

script.name: Save the galaxy
Add the Workshop mod to modconfig.lua
script.description: Adds the Workshop item to the galaxy's modconfig.lua. The server downloads and loads it when it starts.

script.name: Remove the Workshop mod from modconfig.lua
script.description: Removes the Workshop item from the galaxy's modconfig.lua.

script.name: Prepare the Linux server
script.description: Makes bin/AvorionServer executable and installs missing shared libraries (apt, dnf or yum).
